title: Cross-browser testing: Build a repeatable browser and input-device coverage matrix instead of assuming passing Chromium tests prove Safari and Firefox behavior.
description: Design QA lesson for cross-browser testing with a reproducible starter defect, instructor repair, offline regression suite and explicit browser and accessibility limits.
objectives: Build a repeatable browser and input-device coverage matrix instead of assuming passing Chromium tests prove Safari and Firefox behavior.
Repair the reproducible defect in ui-browser-coverage.
Identify real user, accessibility or browser QA beyond cross-browser testing source tests.
rubric: I can explain the methodology behind cross-browser testing.
I can fix the 08.04.06 bug and validate a negative case.
I can name direct accessibility or UX evidence that the source model cannot provide.
